status: DRAFT - Moonwon to approve or edit BEFORE any historical run
source_calendar: Conab, Acompanhamento da Safra Brasileira de Cafe, 3rd survey 2026 (Sept 2026), Quadro 1, Minas Gerais: flowering Aug-Nov, pinhead fruit Nov-Dec, fruit expansion Dec-Jan, grain filling Jan-Apr, maturation Apr-Jun, harvest May-Oct.
chosen_without_outcomes: Windows come from the published crop calendar and the midterm 2021 frost slide; no price outcomes were consulted.

frost_nights.note: Worst region, not average. 3.5 C is the lowest round threshold at which all four documented damaging Brazilian frost winters (1981, 1994, 2000, 2021) register at grid level in the six-region pull; 3.0 C missed 2021 (coldest grid night 3.05 C, Sul de Minas, 20 Jul 2021). Calibrated on weather and the agronomic record only, no price outcomes; note that 2021 is also remembered for its price spike. See docs/V5_DATA_NOTES.md.

grain_fill_heat_days.note: Optional. Left OFF (null) unless Moonwon sets a threshold before the run.
